# eext-jlc-order-dfm-checker attribution

This JLC preflight work was informed by the public project:

- Project: `easyeda/eext-jlc-order-dfm-checker`
- Repository: https://github.com/easyeda/eext-jlc-order-dfm-checker
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Reference revision reviewed: `afd538786d510f537ad4fa47c6329e6a99dc7625`

The KiCadRoutingTools implementation does not depend on EasyEDA at runtime. It adapts the public project's separation of JLC process standards, geometry checks and structured DFM results to the existing KiCadRoutingTools `PCBData` model. EasyEDA UI/API integration code is intentionally not included.

The upstream project's Apache-2.0 license and notices remain applicable to any upstream code or substantial portions reused from that project. This file records provenance for maintainers and future rule updates.
